result.topic_en: A geometric construction relating the stereographic and the central (gnomonic) projection of the sphere, with scales chosen so that the stereographic scale at the pole is half that of the central projection.

methods.what: Stereographic and central projection scaled so the stereographic scale at the pole is half the central one; then the circle on AB represents the equator stereographically and the 45° parallel centrally
methods.quote:
Der Kreis durch AB stellt für erstere den Aequator für letztere
den Parallel von $45^\circ$ vor.

methods.what: Construction converting a central-projection point Q to the stereographic point P of the same sphere point: AP bisects angle CAQ
methods.quote:
P u. Q Darstellung eines und desselben Punkts der Kugel in

Winkel $CAP = PAQ$

methods.what: Stereographic image of the antipodal point: D on line QPC with AD perpendicular to PA
methods.quote:

methods.what: Stereographic image of the great circle having the given point as pole is the circle with centre Q and radius QA
methods.quote:
Ein Kreis um den Mittelpunkt Q mit Radius QA ist die stereo-
graphische Darstellung desjenigen grössten Kreises
der jenen Kugelpunkt zum Pole hat

items.english: If AD is perpendicular to PA and D lies on the extension of QPC, then D is the stereographic representation of the point opposite to that point of the sphere.

items.quote:
Ein Kreis um den Mittelpunkt Q mit Radius QA ist die stereo-
graphische Darstellung desjenigen grössten Kreises
der jenen Kugelpunkt zum Pole hat
items.english: A circle about the centre Q with radius QA is the stereographic representation of the great circle which has that point of the sphere as its pole.
